samples.description: An example request to retrieve a list of GeographicLocations: One GeoJsonPoint for three of the six buildings on the campus.
An example request to retrieve a specific GeographicLocation: The GeoJsonPoint for Babbage House which has an id of "6d8e3c7a-8586"
An example request to retrieve a specific GeographicLocation: The GeoJsonPoint for Faraday House which has an id of "7e73fac4-39c6"
An example request to create a GeographicLocation to describe a GeoJsonPoint for the Pavillion building - the resulting GeographicLocation is 8252cd7c-bd6c

An example request to update the GeographicLocation which has an id of "8252cd7c-bd6c" (the Pavillion) - To JSON-PATCH 'add' a bounding box (GeoJSON's 'bbox' attribute giving a list of two coordinates to list opposite corners of the bounding box). The full updated response is returned.
An example request to delete the GeographicLocation that describes the Pavillion
